promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Geometry/layout authority: every block's size, position and outline
Image 2: Material/style only; not layout

Asset: a sheet of separate top-down tactical-game sprites: the furniture and kit of the rooms off an abandoned Domain-era megastructure plant's service corridors (control room, workshop, lab, crew quarters, stores) in a spacefaring civilization, seen from directly above (orthographic, 90 degrees, no perspective), for the Starsector Marines battle map. One cell is about one soldier wide.
Geometry: reference 1 is the layout authority. Reskin each grey block-out in place: keep every piece exactly inside its block, at its size, position and outline; do not move, enlarge, merge or add pieces. The transparent space between and around blocks stays fully transparent. Every piece stands against a wall along its TOP edge: its back is the top edge, its working face (screens, doors, drawers, the side a person uses) faces DOWN the image into the room.
Style: match reference 2 (the same plant's works-hall kit) for material: crisp painterly-pixel game sprite, blue-gray and gunmetal plate, dark recessed seams, bolted edges, worn ochre trim, small dim amber or cyan status lights, long dead and dusty, adult military sci-fi; detail that still reads when shrunk to 128 px a cell. Not cartoon, no thick outlines, no bright saturated flat colours. Each piece must read as its own thing: never repeat one design across pieces.
View: strictly top-down. Only top surfaces are visible: never a front face or side wall in perspective. Soft upper-left object-local light.
Background: true transparent background with clean alpha; no floor, base tile, shadow slab, border, labels or text (a mimic board's diagram has no readable letters).

Each mimic board is a wall-mounted control-room board seen from above: a shallow steel cabinet along the wall, its long face a dark mimic panel showing a schematic of its own line in coloured lines, nodes and small lamps, all different: see the list.
Subjects, top row, left to right:
1. cold-loop-board (3x1): The control room's mimic board of its hall's line: cryostat loop temperatures.
2. culture-board (3x1): The control room's mimic board of its hall's line: culture vat states.
3. print-queue-board (3x1): The control room's mimic board of its hall's line: the print queue.
Subjects, second row, left to right:
4. lattice-board (3x1): The control room's mimic board of its hall's line: AI core burn-in states.
5. field-board (3x1): The control room's mimic board of its hall's line: the fusion torus field.
6. beam-board (3x1): The control room's mimic board of its hall's line: the synchrotron beam position.
Subjects, third row, left to right:
7. bore-board (3x1): The control room's mimic board of its hall's line: bore depth and torque.
